question: What condition affects even the wise at the point of nectar and essence?
premises: The verse refers to the tip of nectar.
It also refers to the tip of essence.
Even a wise person is described as burning.
inference: Even the wise experience a burning condition at the subtle point of nectar and essence.
uncertainties: The imagery of amṛta+agraṃ and rasa+agreṇa is doctrinally compressed.
plain_english: Even the wise one burns at the tip of nectar, at the tip of essence.
